## 类型 / Type

## 验证清单 / Verification Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_all.py skills/` 通过，无报错
- [ ] `python scripts/prompt_lint.py "..."` 通过，无 error 级别问题
- [ ] 未引入 slop 词汇（如 "cinematic masterpiece"、"breathtaking" 等空洞修饰）
- [ ] 如涉及目录结构或技能索引变更，已更新 README
